Zero-dependency memory system for AI agents. Semantic + working + episodic memory in one file.

A deterministic, tamper-evident safety harness for AI agents. Every decision is hash-chained and replayable, and the agent has episodic memory. Little Nemo solves mazes from vision inside LithoKraft, a voxel test world.
🧠 Curated & live-monitored directory of open-source cognitive architectures, episodic memory engines, world models, and embodiment frameworks for Sentient & Autonomous AI (Updated Daily).
OpenSRE — the memory-first AI SRE. Self-hosted incident investigation with episodic memory, knowledge graph, web console, Slack & Teams. opensre.in
A memory system for AI agents modeled on human memory: episodic, affective, reconstructive.
GenAI-powered multimodal life-review narrative intervention prototype for older adults' autobiographical-episodic memory (research demo).
State-of-the-art Web Search Chat Agent built with Brain-Vault Multi-View Episodic Memory, AgentBridge Governance, zero-key search failover & JWT auth.

Affect-aware episodic memory for LLM agents, based on Affective Field Theory (AFT). Python library, beta. Recall ranks by meaning plus valence, arousal and mood. It is not a general RAG replacement. Benchmark datasets are published on Hugging Face, with a card that lists the main negative results.

A unified Adaptive Trust Graph Consensus (ATGCO) framework for Multi-Agent Intrusion Detection. Features dynamic trust evolution (DTEN), graph episodic memory, differentiable consensus optimization, zero-day detection, and an interactive simulation dashboard.

Local-first autonomous cognitive runtime and sovereign skill registry for AI agents: bounded context admission, persistent episodic memory, multi-model neural routing, Stark-grade holographic cockpit, and fail-closed cryptographic verification.
A reference implementation of the Episodes open specification: episodic memory that keeps its standpoint

A modular Rust-based self-learning episodic memory system for AI agents, featuring hybrid storage with Turso (SQL) and redb (KV), async execution tracking, reward scoring, reflection, and pattern-based skill evolution. Designed for real-world applicability, maintainability, and scalable agent workflows.

Arestrix is an AI Agent Operating System that provides a visual environment for building, coordinating, and running autonomous and multi-agent applications. It combines workflow orchestration, episodic memory, real-time observability, and LLM integration, allowing developers to design, test, and deploy intelligent agent ecosystems at scale.
Edge Efficient Episodic Memory Aid
High-speed, fact-grounded conversational agent with single-tool Web Search, temporal episodic memory, and real-time citation streaming.
Telegram persona runtime with episodic memory, affect (PAD + appraisal), social pain, rumination, circadian sleep and sleep-time consolidation. In active development.
Local-first companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness: persona, episodic memory, mood, and a web room.
Checkpointing for agent sessions that snapshots the full working state of files, env, agent memory, and declared database bundles, so any run can resume, fork, or rewind.
Version-controlled memory for AI agents — Doltgres-backed, MCP-native. Human notes in Obsidian, agent memory in flint.
Local test range for agent memory poisoning - watch a planted memory steer an agent, then prove the repair. Synthetic targets, scripted deterministic agent.

Agentic memory system over 138 AMI meeting transcripts: hybrid retrieval (SQLite FTS5 + ChromaDB), a decision ledger that tracks what changed across meetings, and a code-verified citation checker. Built for the Catalist Agentic AI Intern build test.

Agent platform in Kotlin: JSONL event bus, hybrid RAG over pgvector (cosine + tsquery, RRF), agent memory with LLM extraction and decay, evals with recall gates, and a ZCode MCP plugin — orchestrated on KAP
a mini agent memory engine
Claude Code-style workflow for Google Antigravity agents: memory, a safety guard, several agents on one project, checks of every edit, autonomy. macOS, Linux, Windows.
Project-local agent memory, shared embedding and HTCondor coordination, and reusable agent skills.
Official documentation for Grafeno, a graph engine for agent memory and knowledge.
LINA: agents, memory, records and channels. A fork of Hermes Agent.

IQVO landing page: static HTML served by nginx. A domain-driven design study and an open experiment in AI agents, memory and harness engineering. Not a product.
1,605 ready-to-use AI agent skills from 33 open-source repos — presentations, video, deep research, UI/UX, coding, agents & memory — in one place. Verbatim, with full credits.
A unified simulator for fair comparison of agent memory systems
Distributed hybrid search engine in Rust: BM25 + HNSW, own Raft replication, sharding with global IDF, MCP agent memory
Agent memory anchored to code: memories get flagged when the code they describe changes.

Pre-registered benchmark: when a stored fact about a codebase goes stale, does a coding-agent memory tool still serve it? Protocol, generator, runner, scorer, task files and run manifests. Apache-2.0.
Frontend-only AI Bot City Simulator — Vite, React, TypeScript, Phaser 3, Zustand, Dexie. A living isometric town with autonomous agents, memories, and a real simulation engine.

OntoGr Agent Memory is an open source Python library that stores what an agent learned, where it learned it, and when it was true. It ingests source material as episodes, extracts entities and facts, resolves duplicate entities, reconciles facts on two time axes, and returns a budgeted context block that is ready for an answering model.
